name: Fulin Sodium-ion Battery Energy Storage Station, Nanning, Guangxi (China Southern Power Grid / HiNa Battery)
description: China's first large-scale sodium-ion BESS; first phase 10 MWh entered operation 11 May 2024; 42 battery containers and 21 PCS units at full build-out (1 July 2024 completion reported)

sources.note: Electrek, 17 May 2024 (operation 11 May 2024); HiNa Battery news, 1 Jul 2024 (world's largest Na-ion BESS, 42 containers + 21 PCS); read 2026-10-28
